en.description:
Watchaga – The Ultimate Retro Space Shooter for Apple Watch!

Take off into an intergalactic battle in Watchaga, the ultimate top-down space shooter designed exclusively for Apple Watch! Inspired by classic arcade shoot ‘em ups, Watchaga brings fast-paced action, enemy waves, and powerful upgrades right to your wrist.

Features:

- Classic Shoot ‘Em Up Gameplay – Dodge enemy fire and take down waves of invaders in thrilling space battles.
- Dynamic Enemy Waves – Face challenging enemy patterns, each with unique movement and attack styles.
- Upgrade Your Ship – Collect power-ups to enhance your firepower and unleash devastating bombs.
- Pixel Art Aesthetic – Retro-inspired visuals with a modern touch, bringing nostalgia to your wrist.
- Game Center Integration – Compete for the highest score on the global leaderboards!
- Customizable Experience – Toggle music and touch controls via the companion iOS app.

Are you ready to defend the galaxy? Download Watchaga now and prove your skills in the ultimate space battle!
en.releaseNotes: This app has been updated by Apple to prepare for watchOS 27 compatibility. No new features are included.
